profile.headline: 🔹 Software Development Expert | Leader in Machine Learning and Software Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I have over 16 years of experience in the technology industry, focusing on promoting efficient software development, building machine learning systems, and developing and maintaining large-scale software infrastructure. I am currently a Staff Software Engineer/TLM at Google, responsible for the technical leadership of the Shopping Ads infrastructure, and continuously promoting innovation and technical optimization. Prior to this, I provided support for multiple core projects as a Senior Software Engineer, accumulating rich experience in project management and cross-team collaboration.

Before Google, I worked as a Senior Software Development Engineer at Yahoo, focusing on machine learning and software engineering, and successfully delivered multiple projects with wide-ranging impacts. My career experience in well-known companies in the industry has given me a deep understanding of efficiently solving complex problems and promoting technological change.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer/TLM
positions.description:
Leading the Shopping Ads Infrastructure team to scale and optimize ad performance. Focus on integrating machine learning models into high-traffic systems, improving user engagement and ad relevance.
Managed cross-functional teams, driving key decisions to align technical strategies with business goals.
Key Technologies: ML algorithms, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed large-scale Machine Learning models and enhanced Software Infrastructure, which significantly improved processing speed and data handling efficiency.
Played a pivotal role in improving system robustness, reducing latency for critical pipelines, and contributing to core platform performance improvements.
Key Projects: Real-time data analytics, predictive modeling for user behavior, cloud scaling.
positions.insights: Machine Learning, Software Infrastructure and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated on foundational software infrastructure projects that facilitated seamless integration of ML systems, improving overall system reliability.
Improved the automation of deployment pipelines and optimized backend processes, enabling faster product iterations.
Technologies: C++, Python, Kubernetes, TensorFlow.
positions.insights: Software Industry, Software Infrastructure and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the development of machine learning solutions to enhance personalized content recommendations.
Optimized backend services, reducing computation costs and increasing throughput for key Yahoo services.
Collaborated across teams on system designs to meet scaling demands for millions of users.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Assisted in developing features for Yahoo’s internet software division, including early work in C++ and Java for large-scale web applications.
Gained hands-on experience in Internet Software systems, working alongside senior engineers on backend optimizations.
